story: Mount Tamalpais State Park is located in Marin County, California, and features the 2,571 feet Mount Tamalpais. The mountain covers around 25,000 acres of mostly redwood and oak forests.
matters: The park has about 60 miles of hiking trails connected to a larger, 200-mile network of trails in neighboring public lands. Muir Woods National Monument is surrounded by the state park.
name: Mount Tamalpais State Park
